notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin attached to Sunstrike Legionnaire.
Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Sunstrike Legionnaire by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the token Sunstrike Legionnaire enters the battlefield, each Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.
